debit.notes: No 24x7 toll-free hotline, SMS block keyword or hotlist number is published anywhere on the bank's official site; the only published numbers are chargeable Ahmedabad Head Office lines 079-27459000 and 079-27459905, with no operating hours stated and no overseas/NRI line. The only documented lost-card channel is the Report Frauds web form, which asks the reporter to supply the ATM card number and linked account number and, for mobile-banking theft, the registered mobile number of the lost phone. Internet Banking (retail https://online.gsc.bank.in/OnlineGSCB/login, corporate https://online.gsc.bank.in/OnlineGSCB/corpLogin) and the official GSC Bank mobile-banking app are live channels, but the bank publishes no card-block menu path for either. The bank's Cyber Awareness page mentions the national Cyber Crime Helpline 1930 and cybercrime.gov.in.

credit.notes: The bank does not issue credit cards: the official site's product catalogue lists only the RuPay Platinum Debit Card and no credit-card product, page or blocking channel exists anywhere on the site (the only 'Debit / Credit Cards' wording is generic ATM acceptance of other banks' cards). The Head Office lines and the Report Frauds form listed under 'debit' are the only published contacts applicable in any card emergency. The old entry repeated the same unverified toll-free/netbanking claims for credit as for debit; both are now dropped.

upi.notes: No self-service UPI block/freeze path is published anywhere on the bank's official site (site search for 'upi' and 'block' returns only service/marketing pages): the mobile-banking page's feature list has no UPI module — the only card control published is 'Activation/deactivation and Transaction limit customization for ATM/POS/ECOM' — and the official app-store listings (Play, updated Sep 29 2026; App Store v1.4.8) mention no UPI or freeze feature, so no in-app UPI lock can be verified; the internet-banking page publishes no card/UPI management feature (funds transfer NEFT/RTGS/IMPS only); and no SMS keyword or *99# usage for UPI appears on any fetched page. The bank's UPI page documents UPI only as 'Third Party Apps like Google Pay, PhonePe, PayTM etc.' (24x7x365, Rs 1,00,000 per transaction/day, Rs 5,000 cap for 24 hrs after new registration or PIN change) with no lock/freeze/deregister step, and the UPI QR page's 'flag the QR in Blacklist' wording is merchant-acquirer QR policy, not a customer UPI freeze. Closest published emergency channels for UPI: the complaints form (https://gsc.bank.in/complaints/) offers complaint type 'RTGS/NEFT/IMPS/UPI/BBPS/PPI' with escalation via the Nivaran portal (https://gscb7004.nivaran.in/) and nodal officer contacts (079-27459021); the Report Frauds form covers 'Unauthorized/Suspicious Transaction that have taken place, on any of the GSC Bank Electronic Payment Channels'; and the UPI page itself displays the Head Office lines 079-27459000 / 079-27459905 with no operating hours stated. WhatsApp Banking (+91 8866636364, 'Hi' to start) lists no UPI/block feature; the bank's Cyber Awareness page repeats the national helplines — 'National police helpline number is 112. National women helpline number is 181 and Cyber Crime Helpline is 1930' — and cybercrime.gov.in. Because the bank documents UPI only through third-party apps, any bank-side freeze would have to be requested via the phone/frm channels above; third-party-app-side controls sit outside the bank's published pages.
